main_text.l: di, ubi docemur naturalia plenius, & insuper

l.i: Schola Gratiæ hic à nobis tractatur in genere, qua-
tenus quilibet Christianus philosophus eam debet fre-
quentare. Nam infra in specie præcipiemus fusius de
Schola Gratiæ, quatenus Theologus eam frequentat.
Ad hæc tradimus principia communia omnibus
omnino facultatibus. Sane JCtus æque in suis dispu-
tationibus debet respicere cynosuram S. literarum,
atq; Theologus: æque debet meminisse, se esse Christi-
anum, atq; Theologus. O utinam hodie id perpende-
rent philosophi, JCti & Medici! Putant boni illi viri,
sacram Scripturam esse principium cognoscendi Theo-
logicum: ideoq; committi μετάβασιν εἰς ἄλλο
γένῳ[?], si illi sequantur præscriptum S. literarum. Confide-
rare debebant, scripturam confiderari communiter
& singulariter. Communiter, quatenus omnes &
singuli Christiani illi operam dare debent. Singula-
riter, quatenus Theologi cumprimis illius studio se
addicere debent. Scriptura communiter confiderata
& naturalia plenius tradit, & supernaturalia natu-
ralibus adjicit. Itaq; homo & qua homo, & qua
Christianus, illius normam sequi debet.

page.notes: Printed text in the left margin: "Schola Gra-tiæ." and "Scriptura sacra confi-ratur Communi-ter & Singulari-ter." The Greek phrase "μετάβασιν εἰς ἄλλο γένῳ" is copied from a faint scan; the final word is doubtful. The accents are not clear on every word. Printed spelling kept: "confiderari", "perpende-rent", "Itaq;". A stray mark at the left margin near the lower notes is ignored. The right edge strip belongs to the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.
